Cpcw.diffs.source:
/-- The multiset of ordered differences `B i j - B i l` (subtraction in `Fin v`, i.e. modulo
`v`) over all codewords `i` and all ordered pairs `(j, l)` of distinct positions `j ≠ l`. -/
def diffs {v k n : ℕ} (B : Fin n → Fin k → Fin v) : Multiset (Fin v) :=
  ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n × Fin k × Fin k)).filter fun t => t.2.1 ≠ t.2.2).val.map
    fun t => B t.1 t.2.1 - B t.1 t.2.2
Cpcw.diffs.reading: The source (p. 1) writes △C = {c_i − c_j | i ≠ j} for one codeword; Cpcw.diffs is the multiset union of these over all codewords, indexed by positions (i, j, l) with j ≠ l. For injective tuples positions and elements correspond bijectively. [written]

Cpcw.IsCPCW.source:
/-- `B` is a `(v, k, 1)` CPCW code (difference form): every codeword consists of `k` distinct
residues modulo `v`, every nonzero residue occurs at most once in the multiset of ordered
differences, and the residue `0` never occurs in it. -/
def IsCPCW {v k n : ℕ} (B : Fin n → Fin k → Fin v) : Prop :=
  (∀ i : Fin n, Function.Injective (B i)) ∧
    (∀ d : Fin v, d.val ≠ 0 → (diffs B).count d ≤ 1) ∧
    (∀ d : Fin v, d.val = 0 → (diffs B).count d = 0)
Cpcw.IsCPCW.reading: Source p. 2: the auto-correlation property means that all differences of a codeword are different, and the cross-correlation property means △C1 ∩ △C2 = ∅; with k-subsets these say that every residue occurs at most once in the combined multiset (and 0 never occurs). Cpcw.isCPCW_iff_correlation (CpcwKernel.Facts, [kernel]) proves IsCPCW equivalent to Definition 1 itself: k-subsets C_i = image (B i) with |C_i ∩ (C_i + t)| ≤ 1 for t ≠ 0 and |C_i ∩ (C_j + t)| ≤ 1 for i < j. Fin v with core Fin.sub is Z_v (Cpcw.sub_eq_iff_modEq, [kernel]).

Cpcw.IsOptimalCPCW.reading: Source p. 2: the size of a (v,k,1) CPCW code cannot exceed ⌊(v − 1)/(k(k − 1))⌋, and codes reaching this bound are called optimal. Natural-number division is the floor. The bound itself is kernel-checked for every family (Cpcw.IsCPCW.le_bound). [written for the identification, kernel for the bound]

Cpcw.Target.reading: An optimal (v,k,1) CPCW code exists (some n, with n forced by IsOptimalCPCW). [written]

Cpcw.OptimalTarget.source:
/-- A `(v, k, 1)` CPCW code with `⌊(v - 1) / (k (k - 1))⌋` codewords exists, and no `(v, k, 1)`
CPCW code has more codewords. -/
def OptimalTarget (v k : ℕ) : Prop :=
  Target v k ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ B : Fin n → Fin k → Fin v, IsCPCW B → n ≤ (v - 1) / (k * (k - 1))
Cpcw.OptimalTarget.reading: Target v k together with the upper bound n ≤ (v − 1)/(k(k − 1)) for every family satisfying IsCPCW: the maximum size equals the stated bound. [written]

claim_scope: Eight finite existence statements, each at the optimal bound ⌊(v − 1)/(k(k − 1))⌋ with the bound proved for every family. Not difference families (a perfect code is kernel-proved impossible for each case), no nonexistence claim, no classification. Correctness only: novelty, priority and significance are separate audits.
